summary: Implemented src/cli/format.ts with TTY/NO_COLOR colour decisions, text status labels, 80-column tables, column shrinking/dropping, and full-value detail lines; routed list, status, and config through it. Added 19 format tests plus command-level TTY/NO_COLOR coverage. Typecheck, lint, focused tests, the 623-test suite, build, and manual PTY/plain/JSON checks pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented src/cli/format.ts with TTY/NO_COLOR colour decisions, text status labels, 80-column tables, column shrinking/dropping, and full-value detail lines; routed list, status, and config through it. Added 19 format tests plus command-level TTY/NO_COLOR coverage. Typecheck, lint, focused tests, the 623-test suite, build, and manual PTY/plain/JSON checks pass.
decisions: Colour is enabled only when NO_COLOR is absent, TERM is not dumb, and the output stream reports isTTY; status meaning always comes from the text label.

Tables shrink optional REF/IMAGE columns first, then drop them and print full values on detail lines; NAME and PORT never shrink below their content, and any value that must be clipped also appears in full on a labelled detail line.
Read commands build the formatter from their injected stdout and environment, so tests force TTY, pipe, and NO_COLOR without process globals.
Doctor output was left uncoloured; it already uses text labels and meets PRD-ACC-02 without adding colour.
interfaces: detectColor, noColorRequested, displayWidth, stripAnsi, wrapText, formatField, formatTable, OUTPUT_WIDTH, TableColumn, TableRow
formatListReport(rows, formatter?), formatStatusReport(rows, formatter?), formatConfigReport(record, spec, formatter?)
agentReportedTests: manual PTY list: ANSI around status label; NO_COLOR/pipe: no ANSI; list --json: no ANSI
warnings: doctor --json exits 2 on this host because Railpack and BuildKit are absent; the JSON document itself is valid schemaVersion 1 and free of ANSI.
`formatField`'s third positional argument changed from a number to an options object; no documented CLI surface changed.
validationLimitations: Real TTY behaviour was exercised through the built CLI under `script` and through an injected isTTY recorder, not an interactive human terminal; screen-reader behaviour was reasoned from text-only output, not tested with assistive software.
payload.taskDescription: Implement format.ts and route the read commands through it. Decide color from TTY and NO_COLOR, render status labels as text, fit tables to 80 columns, and move long values to a detail line rather than truncating them. Tests run with forced TTY, forced non-TTY, NO_COLOR set, and an 80-column width, asserting no ANSI escapes in non-color modes and no row wider than 80 columns.
